stories.title: Letters | Hong Kong need not build its ‘AI City Brain’ from scratch
stories.simple_summary: A newspaper opinion piece discusses whether Hong Kong should build its own AI city system or use existing technology from elsewhere.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly concerns government leaders in Hong Kong — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: War of words: Newsom orders California to say AI after Trump’s ‘superintelligence’ decree
stories.simple_summary: California's governor is disagreeing with another leader about what to call advanced AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political disagreement about words — it doesn't affect how AI works or how you'd use it.

stories.title: FTC launches broad investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: The government's consumer protection agency is investigating whether AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic are following the law.
stories.why_it_matters: These investigations help make sure AI companies treat customers fairly, though the results will take time.

stories.title: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk's company SpaceX released an updated version of an AI encyclopedia website with a new look and logo.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one of many AI encyclopedias being built — it's interesting but doesn't affect your daily life yet.

stories.title: 'Poured jet fuel on AI:' NC's secret weapon for faster audits as experts urge human oversight
stories.simple_summary: North Carolina is using AI to speed up government audits (checking that money is spent correctly), but experts want humans to double-check the results.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make government work faster and catch mistakes better, though humans should still verify what the AI finds.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
stories.simple_summary: Google released a new, more powerful version of its AI tool called Gemini, designed to help with computer coding and cybersecurity.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to tech professionals and large companies — most small-business owners won't directly use this.

stories.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans AI 'robo bosses' in landmark state law, reversing his earlier veto
stories.simple_summary: California passed a new law banning "robot bosses" (AI systems making all the employment decisions) and the governor agreed to it after earlier saying no.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have employees or might hire workers, this law protects workers from being treated unfairly by AI alone — a human must be involved in major job decisions.

stories.title: China has cracked down on AI relationships. Is it ahead of the game?
stories.simple_summary: China is restricting how AI can be used in romantic or relationship-based services and conversations.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects tech companies operating in China — it doesn't affect you unless you use Chinese AI dating or companion services.

stories.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
stories.simple_summary: Several investment groups are giving $750 million to a startup making AI tools for designing computer hardware.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers — it's not relevant to typical small-business owners.

stories.title: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
stories.simple_summary: Google released a powerful new AI tool for software engineers, lawyers, and cybersecurity experts, but only certain trusted professionals can use it right now.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you're a software engineer or cybersecurity specialist, this doesn't affect you yet.

stories.title: Congress Set to Leave Washington for the Midterms With No A.I. Progress
stories.simple_summary: U.S. Congress is leaving to campaign for elections without passing any new laws about AI regulation.
stories.why_it_matters: This means there will be no new national rules on AI from the government for now — regulations stay as they are.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Google announced details about a new advanced AI model called Gemini 4 Argon that it says represents the next big step forward.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one of many powerful AI tools being released — it's similar to earlier announcements from Google and other companies.
